name: vn-terminal-frontend
description: VN Terminal Pro frontend: HTML/CSS/TypeScript workstation over contracts/openapi.yaml. See vn_terminal_multi_ai_development_plan.md v1.1, Section 12.

_versionNotes.lightweight-charts: Section 7: 'Charting: TradingView Lightweight Charts.' Apache 2.0; attribution must be retained (Section 12.2).
_versionNotes.typescript: Section 7: 'Frontend logic: TypeScript or modern JavaScript ES modules.' Not itself required by the plan; pinned because contracts/schemas/json can be typed against via a generator the frontend specialist chooses.
_versionNotes.@playwright/test: Section 7: 'End-to-end tests: Playwright.' Version aligned with the Python playwright package pinned in pyproject.toml (verified 2026-07-30) since both should exercise the same browser binaries; see contracts/OPEN_ITEMS.md.
_versionNotes.bundler: OPEN ITEM: the plan does not specify a frontend build tool (Vite, esbuild, or none). None is added here; see contracts/OPEN_ITEMS.md, section C.
